title: c1 major DE: typed decode after a passing schema pair misdirects — the drift class has no home
description: Evidence: mod.rs:151-158 — a decode failure AFTER pair validation gets kind malformed and repair-the-artifact recovery, but the artifact just passed its pair; the real defect is struct/schema drift (live example: u32 vs unbounded integer — 4294967296 passes the pair, fails decode). Disposition: own kind for loader/pair disagreement with toolkit-naming recovery + a drift test decoding a minimal pair-valid instance per class. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit daacdc84): the decode-after-pair branch is the loader-pair-disagreement kind naming the toolkit as the broken party, with the empty recovery action as the explicit no-adopter-act signal; numeric widths align to the pairs' unbounded integers (u64), closing the live drift vector. RESIDUE, declared: the per-class minimal-instance drift test is deferred — no mechanical struct-introspection path exists without a schemars-class dependency, which is a PE-flagged dependency decision, not a fix-pass slip-in; the round-2 verify judges the partial. Validator: solution-architect.
